### Describe the Bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is and what you expected to happen.

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Open Genshin Companion.
2. Click on '...'
3. See error.

### Error Messages / Logs
If applicable, paste any error logs or stack traces here. Check `%LOCALAPPDATA%\GenshinWishTracker` for any saved logs.

### Application Screen
- **App Version:** [e.g., v1.0.3]
- **Windows Version:** [e.g., Windows 10 / Windows 11]

### Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here (e.g., "Happened right after the Genshin game update", "Fails during local web cache syncing").
